description: WHP Standing Mark Service (POST /v1/evaluate): Submit material through the single evaluation door. A sovereign Large Language Model given Decision Integrity Version 7 (The Continuous Work) examines whether the submitted record warrants the requested operation within stated scope and emits an object-bound, Ed25519-signed Standing Mark Record (POSITIVE_STANDING_MARK when established; NEGATIVE_STANDING_FINDING when not established). Payment buys the examination, never a favorable outcome.

response.integration_rule: A positive Standing Mark is a signed, scope-bound examination result. It may satisfy an evidence requirement defined by a receiving system, but it does not itself authorize an action. The receiving system must independently evaluate the applicable authority, conditions, and action policy. Absence of a positive Mark means the Mark requirement has not been satisfied; it does not, by itself, establish that the underlying action is prohibited.
